test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Wicked
solution:
The correct answer is 'Moral'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word** 'wicked'** means morally very bad.(चरित्रहीन, भ्रष्‍ट; बुरा, दुष्‍ट, पापी)

 
 
• ***Example: **His character is obscene and he is a **wicked** person.*
 
 
 
• *​*We need to choose its **antonym** from the given options.
 
• The marked option** 'Moral' **means relating to beliefs about what is right or wrong.(उचित-अनुचित से संबंधित; नैतिक)
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Other options-**

 
• Evil- morally bad; causing trouble or harming people (बुरा, दुष्‍ट, पापी; लोगों को दुखी करने वाला)
 
• Sinful- breaking a religious law; immoral (धार्मिक नियम को भंग करने वाला; पापपूर्ण, अनैतिक)
 
• Errant- behaving badly in some way, especially by disobeying your parents or leaving home; not behaving in an acceptable way (अनुचित व्‍यवहार वाला, विशेषतः माता-पिता की अवज्ञा करने वाला या घर छोड़ने वाला; अस्‍वीकार्य आचरण शैली में व्‍यवहार करते हुए)
